data.name: Sharwik
data.gender_notes: Sharwik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharwik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shri', which means 'Goddess of Wealth, Fortune and Prosperity'. The suffix '-ik' denotes 'one who possesses'. So Sharwik can be translated to 'One who possesses the Goddess of Wealth and Fortune'. The name Sharwik carries the meaning “Victorious, Brave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwik usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharwik is a spiritual name that represents the power of the divine within an individual. It signifies the presence of the Goddess of Wealth and Fortune, and inspires the person to be victorious and brave in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Sharwik belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwik total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
